 "data": "%%{init: {'flowchart': {'nodeSpacing': 25, 'rankSpacing': 35, 'padding': 10}}}%%
flowchart LR
 subgraph The_Brain[\"1. The Brain (frontier/scheduler.py & Valkey)\"]
 direction LR
 URLSeen[\"URL Seen Checker<br>(Valkey Bloom Filter)\"]
 ValkeyQ[(\"Valkey Priority Queue<br>(Domain Queues &amp; ZSET)\")]
 Politeness[\"Politeness Coordinator<br>(Atomic Lua ZSET Delay)\"]
 end
 subgraph Broker_Layer[\"2. Message Broker (Redpanda)\"]
 direction LR
 KafkaReady[(\"Topic: ready_urls<br>(16 Partitions)\")]
 KafkaDiscovered[(\"Topic: discovered_urls<br>(16 Partitions)\")]
 end
 subgraph The_Muscle[\"3. The Muscle (worker/fetcher.py)\"]
 direction TB
 Downloader[\"Page Downloader (aiohttp)\"]
 DNS{{\"System DNS\"}}
 Parser[\"HTML Parser (selectolax)\"]
 ContentDup[\"Content Deduplicator<br>(SHA-256 &amp; 64-bit SimHash)\"]
 Archiver[\"WARC Buffer<br>(50MB Rotating .warc.gz)\"]
 LinkExtractor[\"Link Extractor &amp; Filter<br>(Pull a-tags, Strip UTMs)\"]
 end
 subgraph Storage_Layer[\"4. Persistent Storage (Garage & ScyllaDB)\"]
 direction TB
 GarageS3[(\"Garage S3<br>(Blob: .warc.gz)\")]
 ScyllaDB[(\"ScyllaDB<br>(Metadata, SimHash Blocks,<br>WARC Byte Offsets)\")]
 end
 URLSeen -- If Unseen --> ValkeyQ
 ValkeyQ -- Pop Ready --> Politeness
 Downloader <-- IP Lookup --> DNS
 Downloader -- Raw HTML --> Parser
 Parser -- DOM Text --> ContentDup
 ContentDup -- If Unique --> Archiver & LinkExtractor
 Start([\"Crawl Initiator (Seed URLs)\"]) -- Direct Seed Injection --> ValkeyQ
 Politeness -- Publish Ready --> KafkaReady
 KafkaReady -- Consume --> Downloader
 ContentDup <-- \"4x 16-bit Lookup\" --> ScyllaDB
 Archiver -- \"1. Multipart Flush\" --> GarageS3
 Archiver -- \"2. Upsert Offset\" --> ScyllaDB
 LinkExtractor -- Publish Links --> KafkaDiscovered
 KafkaDiscovered -- Consume --> URLSeen

 Start:::init
 URLSeen:::brain
 ValkeyQ:::queue
 Politeness:::brain
 KafkaReady:::queue
 KafkaDiscovered:::queue
 Downloader:::muscle
 DNS:::storage
 Parser:::muscle
 ContentDup:::muscle
 Archiver:::muscle
 LinkExtractor:::muscle
 GarageS3:::storage
 ScyllaDB:::storage
